questions.fact: Released in 1994 – Elton John co-wrote the songs.
"Let It Go" won the Oscar for Best Original Song.
Finding Nemo won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature.
Toy Story (1995) was the first fully computer-animated film.
Jack Black voices Po the panda.
Spider-Man (2002) starred Tobey Maguire as Peter Parker.
In the US, book 1 is called "the Sorcerer's Stone".
Kevin's family flies to Paris without him.
The film series is based on a Disney theme park ride.
E.T. is lured out of hiding with Reese's Pieces.
Robin Williams voiced the Genie in 1992.
Scrat the squirrel spends the whole film chasing an acorn.
The 1977 film was later renamed "A New Hope".
First animated film nominated for Best Picture.
Johnny Depp played Willy Wonka in 2005.
Kong climbs the Empire State Building.
Dumbo never speaks a single word in the film.
The animals escape from New York's Central Park Zoo.
Neo takes the red pill in The Matrix (1999).
Forrest Gump won 6 Oscars, including Best Picture.
Paddington comes from "darkest Peru".
Twister (1996) follows storm chasers in Oklahoma.
Made with stop-motion animation – frame by frame.
The emotions live inside a girl named Riley's head.
Tom Hanks's volleyball friend is called Wilson.
Directed by Christopher Nolan in 2010.
Based on a Stephen King novella.
Based on E. B. White's 1952 children's book.
Natalie Portman won Best Actress for Black Swan.
Meryl Streep plays editor Miranda Priestly.

lines.q: Thirty movies in emojis, from easy to legend, and they get harder every round. Keep score! First one: a lion, plus a crown. Which movie is it?
lines.a: The Lion King! Nineteen ninety four, with songs by Elton John.

lines.q: Snow, plus a princess.
lines.a: Frozen! And yes, now you're singing Let It Go.

lines.q: A little orange fish, plus a magnifying glass.
lines.a: Finding Nemo! A clownfish dad crossing the whole ocean.

lines.q: A cowboy, a rocket, and a teddy.
lines.a: Toy Story! Woody and Buzz, to infinity and beyond.

lines.q: A panda, plus a martial arts belt.
lines.a: Kung Fu Panda! Jack Black is the voice of Po.

lines.q: A spider, a guy, and a big city.
lines.a: Spider-Man! Tobey Maguire, two thousand two. Six for six so far? Nice.

lines.q: Round two, medium. A wizard, a lightning bolt, and glasses.
lines.a: Harry Potter! In America the first one is the Sorcerer's Stone.

lines.q: A house, a boy, and a Christmas tree.
lines.a: Home Alone! His family flew to Paris without him.

lines.q: A pirate flag, waves, and an anchor.
lines.a: Pirates of the Caribbean! It started as a theme park ride.

lines.q: An alien, a bike, and the moon.
lines.a: E.T.! That bike in front of the moon is movie history.

lines.q: A genie, a lamp, and a monkey.
lines.a: Aladdin! Robin Williams was the Genie.

lines.q: Ice, a mammoth, and a squirrel.
lines.a: Ice Age! Scrat just wants his acorn. Okay, it gets tougher now.

lines.q: Round three, hard. A rocket, a star, and swords.
lines.a: Star Wars! A long time ago, in a galaxy far, far away.

lines.q: A rose, a princess, and a beast.
lines.a: Beauty and the Beast! The first cartoon ever nominated for Best Picture.

lines.q: Chocolate, a factory, and a golden ticket.
lines.a: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory! Johnny Depp played Wonka. If you're enjoying this, subscribe and turn on the bell!

lines.q: A giant ape, a city, and planes.
lines.a: King Kong! Up the Empire State Building.

lines.q: An elephant, a big ear, and a circus tent.
lines.a: Dumbo! And fun fact, Dumbo never says a single word.

lines.q: A lion, a zebra, and the Statue of Liberty.
lines.a: Madagascar! They break out of the Central Park Zoo. Still with me?

lines.q: Round four, very hard! Sunglasses, a pill, and a rabbit.
lines.a: The Matrix! Follow the white rabbit, take the red pill.

lines.q: A runner, chocolate, and a shrimp.
lines.a: Forrest Gump! Life is like a box of chocolates.

lines.q: A bear, a coat, and an orange.
lines.a: Paddington! That orange is his marmalade.

lines.q: A tornado, a cow, and a car.
lines.a: Twister! Yes, the flying cow. Love that scene.

lines.q: A pumpkin, a skull, and a Christmas tree.
lines.a: The Nightmare Before Christmas! Jack, the Pumpkin King.

lines.q: A brain, a happy face, and a sad face.
lines.a: Inside Out! Joy and Sadness, living in Riley's head. Last round, here we go.

lines.q: Final round, legend! An island, a volleyball, and a plane.
lines.a: Cast Away! Nobody forgets Wilson.

lines.q: A spiral, sleep, and a city.
lines.a: Inception! Dreams inside dreams inside dreams.

lines.q: A little hammer, a wall, and rain.
lines.a: The Shawshank Redemption! That tiny rock hammer did it all.

lines.q: A pig, a web, and a spider.
lines.a: Charlotte's Web! The spider writes words to save the pig.

lines.q: Three left, stay with me! A swan, a black dot, and ballet shoes.
lines.a: Black Swan! Natalie Portman won the Oscar for it.

lines.q: Final question. A high heel, a devil, and a magazine.
lines.a: The Devil Wears Prada! Meryl Streep as the boss from hell.
